text:
mike: Kicked off POC with FinX this morning. Need to align scope + success criteria. Customer wants realtime summarization of support chats, target median latency <500ms, cost goal ~ $0.0005/token effective, 2-week pilot. Who can own SE support? :raising_hand:

ana: I can own SE for week0-2. Need sample transcripts and expected concurrent users/rps. Also need clarification on PHI/PII — will any transcripts include sensitive data?

julia: Product asks for measurable success criteria: entity-redaction F1 >= 0.85, ROUGE-L >= 0.55 on summaries, and no PII leakage in random audits. They also want the security questionnaire answered before week2. NDA is signed.

srini: For latency, recommend trying r-instruct-16k with q4 or q8 quant and a 4-request batching strategy. We'll do a microbenchmark once we have sample data. Need GPU access + ~8GB KV cache for sessions.

nora: Security: I'll own the questionnaire. Need data flow diagram, retention requirements, and whether attachments are uploaded. We'll require KMS + SOC2 language in the DPA.

mike: Proposed timeline: Week0 (kickoff + data ingest + eval set build), Week1 (baseline runs + monitoring + cost forecast), Week2 (acceptance run, handoff, runbook). Deliverables: eval report, runbook, cost model, and a short decision doc for Dedicated vs Hosted. Feasible?

ana: Feasible if they provide ~10k sample messages and 3-5 golden summaries for calibrating evals. SE time estimate: 8 hrs/week (week0), 12 hrs/week (week1), 4 hrs (week2).

julia: Also question on pricing: Customer asked for a committed Dedicated ballpark. Mike, can you provide expected QPS and monthly token volume so we can model tiers?

mike: Yes — sending usage numbers by EOD.

srini: Quick example prompts for the eval harness: 
```
# Summarization prompt (3-bullet brief)
System: You are a concise support summarizer.
User: Summarize the ticket in 3 bullets, include root cause and next action.
```
We'll run this across 1k samples for ROUGE and human spot checks.

ana: We'll need an eval harness repo + a small script to run locally. Can someone drop a template link?

ops-bot: Calendar: "FinX POC kickoff" Thu 10:00 AM PT — Invite sent to mike, ana, julia, srini, nora.

nora: I'll circulate the checklist for the security questionnaire today. Also confirm: customer will allow attachments but wants malware scanning and redaction checks.

julia: Success criteria checklist (proposed): 1) Median latency <500ms for 95% of requests, 2) Summary quality >= ROUGE-L 0.55 + human thumbs-up on 80% spot checks, 3) No PII leakage in redaction tests, 4) Cost per 1k tokens within agreed band. Assign owners?

ana: Owners: latency -> srini, evals -> ana, security -> nora, pricing -> mike, runbook -> julia.

mike: Can engineering commit to a 2-day quantization spike next week to validate q4 performance?

srini: Yes — I'll allocate 2 days. Will post benchmark numbers and a short runbook here.

julia: Potential blocker: if FinX requires on-prem/private deployment we need an architecture review and legal signoff. I opened ticket #3456 for Private deployment review. @nora can you triage?

nora: On it, will update ticket by EOD with required controls.

mike: Thanks everyone — going to finalize the week-by-week plan and share an updated timeline before EOD. :thumbsup:
